infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used to record voice messages you send in chat. For example: hold the microphone button at the bottom of a chat to record, release to send.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to take photos to share in chat or set as your profile picture. For example: tap the camera icon in the chat input to capture and send a photo.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to pick photos to share in chat or set as your profile picture. For example: tap the photo icon in the chat input to choose a photo from your library and send it.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Used to save photos from chat to your library. For example: tap Save Image on a photo someone shared to download it to your Photos app.
